description: We are a team of five moderately skilled coders passionate about space exploration, AI, and technology. We aim to build MarsPath AI, an interactive Martian map that uses NASA data to help explore Mars, identify terrain hazards, and plan safer routes while highlighting scientific points of interest. Our team combines coding skills, creativity, research, and collaboration to develop a practical, innovative solution for future Mars exploration.
summary:
MARSWALK: JEZERO EXPLORER is an interactive Martian exploration and survival mapping project focused on Jezero Crater, one of the most scientifically significant regions on Mars.

Jezero Crater was once home to an ancient lake and river delta, making it an important location for investigating Mars' geological history and searching for possible evidence of ancient microbial life.

Our project aims to bring together scientific and geographical information from NASA's Mars exploration missions through an integrated map. It is designed to help future astronauts understand Martian terrain, explore scientifically important locations, identify potential hazards, and plan safer and more efficient exploration routes.

By combining planetary science, interactive mapping, and exploration planning, MARSWALK aims to make complex Mars data easier to understand and use.

Our vision is to support safer human exploration of Mars while encouraging new scientific discoveries on the Red Planet.

MARSWALK: JEZERO EXPLORER

An Interactive Martian Survival and Exploration Map

MARSWALK is an interactive Martian exploration platform focused on Jezero Crater, an ancient lake and river delta region on Mars.

Our project aims to combine geographical and scientific information into an integrated map to help future astronauts explore Martian terrain, identify potential hazards, discover scientifically important locations, and plan safer exploration routes.

By connecting NASA's Mars exploration data with interactive mapping, MARSWALK aims to make planetary information easier to understand and support safer, smarter, and more efficient Mars missions.

Technologies: Digital mapping, web development, and NASA scientific data.

Our Mission: To transform Martian data into an accessible exploration guide and help prepare for humanity's future journey to the Red Planet.
